title: Quasi-compact opens of a Galois base change are defined over a finite subextension
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $\bar k/k$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] that is Galois, i.e. separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] and normal (for every $\alpha\in\bar k$ the minimal polynomial of $\alpha$ over $k$ is a product of polynomials of degree one in $\bar k[T]$); it may be of infinite degree. Write $\operatorname{Aut}(\bar k/k)$ for the group of $k$-algebra automorphisms of $\bar k$. Let $X$ be a scheme over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base] and $X_{\bar k}=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}\bar k$ its base change [def-pc-base-change]. For $\sigma\in\operatorname{Aut}(\bar k/k)$ let $\sigma_X=\mathrm{id}_X\times\operatorname{Spec}(\sigma):X_{\bar k}\to X_{\bar k}$ be the base change of the $k$-morphism $\operatorname{Spec}(\sigma):\operatorname{Spec}\bar k\to\operatorname{Spec}\bar k$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]; it is an automorphism of the scheme $X_{\bar k}$, and $(\sigma\circ\tau)_X=\tau_X\circ\sigma_X$. Let $V\subseteq X_{\bar k}$ be a quasi-compact open subset. Then: (1) there are a subfield $k'$ with $k\subseteq k'\subseteq\bar k$ and $\dim_kk'<\infty$, and a quasi-compact open subset $V'\subseteq X_{k'}=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}k'$, such that $V=p^{-1}(V')$, where $p:X_{\bar k}\to X_{k'}$ is the morphism $\mathrm{id}_X\times\operatorname{Spec}(k'\hookrightarrow\bar k)$; (2) for this $k'$, $\sigma_X(V)=V$ for every $\sigma\in\operatorname{Aut}(\bar k/k)$ that fixes $k'$ pointwise. (Stacks states (2) as: $V$ is invariant under an open subgroup of $\operatorname{Gal}(\bar k/k)$; the subgroup fixing a finite subextension is such a subgroup.)
